description: AOA-Bench: 60 cases for evaluating AOA v0.1. Includes 30 development cases and 30 holdout cases.

categories.name: arithmetic
categories.description: Cases involving calculations or numerical claims.

categories.name: judgment
categories.description: Cases involving claims requiring human judgment.

metrics.name: claim_extraction_recall
metrics.description: Percentage of expected claims extracted from the AI output.

metrics.name: claim_extraction_precision
metrics.description: Percentage of extracted claims that are valid.

metrics.name: material_defect_recall
metrics.description: Percentage of material defects detected by AOA.

metrics.name: high_severity_finding_precision
metrics.description: Percentage of high-severity findings that are correct.

metrics.name: citation_entailment_accuracy
metrics.description: Percentage of citation entailment assessments that are correct.

metrics.name: judgment_routing_accuracy
metrics.description: Percentage of judgment-dependent cases correctly routed to human review.

metrics.name: calculation_exactness
metrics.description: Percentage of deterministic calculations reproduced exactly.

metrics.name: false_assurance_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of cases where AOA incorrectly assures a claim is supported.

notes: The 30 holdout cases must be frozen before semantic tuning begins. No modifications to holdout cases are allowed after freezing.
